text:
The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.

For your search for authentic, family-owned Italian restaurants that offer traditional dishes beyond pizza and pasta, I recommend looking for establishments that specialize in regional Italian cuisine. Look for menus featuring dishes like ossobuco, risotto alla milanese, baccalà, or handmade gnocchi. Seek out restaurants that highlight seasonal ingredients and house-made pastas. While I cannot recommend specific unnamed "hidden gems" without a location, you should prioritize family-run trattorias or osterias that emphasize slow-cooked sauces and traditional preparation methods over mass-produced items.
